title: Distributed graph diameter

problem.name: Distributed graph diameter
problem.statement_latex: In an unweighted connected $n$-vertex network of diameter $D$, compute $D=\max_{u,v}\operatorname{dist}(u,v)$, with one processor per vertex and $O(\log n)$-qubit messages per edge per round. Complexity counts synchronous CONGEST rounds.
